summary.title: Quantitative QED comparison battery for the paired-spinor photon
summary.verdict: tree/classical + photon-precision QED reproduced; the Tier-C radiative ledger is CLOSED by the interacting one-loop sector (F251 vacuum polarisation, F252 vertex): a_e=alpha/2pi and running alpha from Pi(q^2) and the Lamb shift all computed, with Ward/WT identities and b0^QED=4/3 exact; and Tier-D adds the full tree S-matrix (F260): Compton/Klein-Nishina, Moller, Bhabha, Dirac annihilation, e+e- -> mu+mu-, plus the positron/charge-conjugation + crossing sector.

A1_masslessness.note: gapless: pure-hop walk A0=0 (F168/B1). Real photon: massless.

A2_luminality.note: massless => moves at c_lat=1/sqrt(3) in every direction.

A3_lorentz_isotropy.quantity: fractional spread of phase speed over directions
A3_lorentz_isotropy.note: isotropy (=> Lorentz invariance) restored as k->0; anisotropy is O(k^2). Real photon: exactly isotropic. Model: continuum-limit.

A4_coulomb_massless_pole.quantity: photon static pole  D^-1 = m^2 + v^2 k^2
A4_coulomb_massless_pole.note: massless pole (m^2->0) in 3-D IS the 1/r Coulomb law, NOT Yukawa e^-mr/r; v^2->1/3 = c_lat^2. alpha sets the physical prefactor and is an INPUT, not predicted. Anisotropy O(1e-4) at k=0.03.

A5_thomson_cross_section.note: classical (Thomson) scattering limit; a tree-level QED number the model's two inputs reproduce.

A6_ward_charge_conservation.quantity: C.(C x B) (curl sources no charge => d_t rho = -i C.J)
A6_ward_charge_conservation.note: tree Ward identity: the U(1) coupling conserves charge exactly (F87).

B1_vacuum_birefringence.quantity: rotation-rate difference between two linear polarisations
B1_vacuum_birefringence.note: both polarisations rotate at the one rate Omega_pair => zero vacuum birefringence (F69 PP2 dynamical). The single-branch value is the split the pair structurally avoids; that chiral photon is excluded by GRB/AGN polarimetry (F65/F66).

B2_photon_mass.note: gap identically 0 => consistent with PDG m_gamma < 1e-18 eV.

B3_dispersion_LIV.note: axis-aligned dispersion exactly linear (F105); LIV is anisotropic and O(k^3), i.e. suppressed by (k a)^2. Consistent with GRB time-of-flight bounds ~15 decades below sensitivity (F28).

C1_electron_g_minus_2.note: a_e = F_2(0) = alpha/2pi computed EXACTLY from the one-loop vertex (parametric integral = 1); 0.15% vs measured. Higher QED orders out of scope (future).

C2_running_alpha.note: photon self-energy built: b0^QED=4/3 exact, Ward-transverse; leptonic Delta alpha(M_Z) matches PDG to <0.3% (1/alpha|lep ~ 132.7). Hadronic pull-down to 128.927 is the QCD sector (F151/F152) — honest scope, not the lepton loop.

C3_lamb_shift.note: the exact Dirac 2s-2p degeneracy (F125) is lifted to +1052.2 MHz = 99.5% of measured 1057.845 MHz. Uehling (-27.1 MHz) derived from F251's Pi; self-energy from the Bethe log. Residual ~5.6 MHz is higher-order alpha(Z alpha)^5/two-loop QED.

D1_compton_klein_nishina.note: full Klein-Nishina (1929): |M|^2 matches the Mandelstam form to machine precision, total sigma(x) reproduces the closed KN form and reduces to Thomson sigma_T as omega->0 (extends A5); Ward exact.

D2_moller_bhabha.note: Moller 1932 / Bhabha 1936 differential cross sections reproduced; the Bhabha<->Moller s<->u crossing relation is exact (sympy).

D3_pair_annihilation.quantity: e+e- -> gamma gamma (Dirac 1930): |M|^2, Bose, Ward, sigma
D3_pair_annihilation.note: Dirac annihilation cross section reproduced; photon Bose symmetry and Ward on both photons exact; needs the positron (v = C ubar^T).

D4_ee_to_mumu.quantity: e+e- -> mu+mu-: |M|^2, total sigma -> 4 pi alpha^2 / 3s
D4_ee_to_mumu.note: the R-ratio unit sigma = (4 pi alpha^2/3s) beta (1+2m^2/s) -> 4 pi alpha^2/3s at high energy; needs the 2nd-generation muon (F121 anchor).
